newsitem.title: USA: Ault sees second half gains, record year.
newsitem.headline: Ault sees second half gains, record year.

text.p: Ault Inc said Thursday it expects second half financial results to benefit from business volumes generated by new customers and new product introductions and it expects record results for its fiscal year.

Ault, which makes external power conversion products, reported fiscal 1997 second quarter earnings rose to $0.12 a share from $0.09 in the year-earlier quarter. Second quarter net sales rose 20 percent to $9.2 million.
Business levels with all of the company's primary telecommunications and data communications customers remain on plan, said Frederick Green, president and chief executive.
"Fiscal 1997 is continuing to shape up as Ault's third consecutive year of record sales and earnings," he said in a statement.
